description: Maren's sister sent three words on oilcloth: 'Salt Market. Low tide.' Then three weeks of nothing.
Council writ with wren-in-ring red wax seal; a Warden wants Maren to carry it; Maren refused.
Black door in old quarter past the cooper's, no street-side handle, wren cut in stone over lintel; Warden wants Maren there by second bell.
Tovin told the green-shawl woman about the ferry from the Reach and their lack of sleep; gave no name.
Identity of the green-shawl woman who questioned Tovin; possibly the same Warden, unconfirmed.
Rope-seller's warning: not the only door in the city with Maren's name near it.
